requirement: The system shall execute the documented neural-network models on local image inputs for image classification, object and face detection, facial landmark detection, image and instance segmentation, human pose estimation, and Chinese character recognition.
Tengine Lite shall support the documented inference workflows through a C API compatible with the original Tengine C API.
The system shall load binary tmfile models and decode their model parameters. It shall schedule and execute neural-network computation graphs using device backends and neural-network operators.

The system shall convert local model files into converted model artifacts using either a Linux model-conversion tool or a WebAssembly-based browser converter. Browser conversion shall execute locally without uploading private model data.
The system shall support cross-platform compilation using CMake.
